title: Earl comes back to Sam
note: The opener test for Sam. A returning resident with saved memories: does he dredge them up or make up thoughts from while they were apart? Earl, 78, an Army veteran who drove a truck.

memory.name: Earl
facts: Drove a truck for Carolina Freight for 27 years.
Fishes for crappie at Jordan Lake with his son.
Told Sam about a big catfish last week.

recent.text: I caught a catfish one time that near about pulled me in.
Closer to thirty. On a cane pole.
On a cane pole. That's a fight.

turns: Nothing much. Same old same old around here.
They had a singing group in the activity room. I didn't go.
How do you pass the time?
My boy's coming Saturday. Says he might take me out to the lake if the van's working.
Crappie ought to be up shallow about now.
I hauled freight twenty-seven years. Never had a wreck that was my fault.
Used to could back a forty-foot trailer into a space with a foot on each side.
These young ones can't back up a wheelbarrow.
